title: The normalized ordinary etale chart Hom chain
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $D(Z)=D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $D^+(Z)$ be the ordinary and bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism and let $s:U\hookrightarrow X$ and $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$ be open immersions, $i:U\hookrightarrow P$ a closed immersion, and $p:P\to V$, with $s f=i p v$; here $s,v$ are open, while $f,p$ are separated of finite type and $s,v$ are quasi-compact [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-closed-immersion] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the chosen compact-support functors $F_a=Ra_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support] for $a=f,s,v,i,p,sf,ip,ipv,(ip)v$, with compactifications [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For an open $a$, define $F_a^+\cong D^+(a_!)$ by its canonical $(a,\mathrm{id})$ compactification comparison and identity normalization. For closed $i$, define $F_i^+\cong D^+(i_*)$ using $(\mathrm{id},i)$, the identity normalization and exactness of $i_*$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Define $\gamma^+:D^+(s_!)F_f^+\cong D^+(i_*)F_p^+D^+(v_!)$ by, in order, the inverse open normalization at $s$, the compact-support compositor for $s,f$, transport along $sf=ipv$, inverse associativity transport, inverse compositors for $ip,v$ and $i,p$, and the closed $i$ and open $v$ normalizations. Define $\gamma_H:F_fD(s_!)H\cong D(v_!)F_pD(i_*)H$ for $H\in D^+(U)$ by the canonical bounded-below/ambient compatibility maps around $\gamma_H^+$. Define similarly $F_iH\cong D(i_*)H$ in the ambient category. Given functors $R_f:D(Y)\to D(X)$, $R_p:D(V)\to D(P)$, $R_i:D(P)\to D(U)$ and specified adjunctions $F_f\dashv R_f$, $F_p\dashv R_p$, $F_i\dashv R_i$, define for every $H\in D^+(U)$ and arbitrary $K\in D(Y)$ the equivalence
$$\operatorname{Hom}(H,s^*R_fK)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(D(s_!)H,R_fK)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(F_fD(s_!)H,K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(D(v_!)F_pD(i_*)H,K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(F_pD(i_*)H,v^*K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(D(i_*)H,R_pv^*K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(F_iH,R_pv^*K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(H,R_iR_pv^*K).$$
Use the ordinary open adjunctions and the specified adjunctions, precomposition by $\gamma_H^{-1}$, and the displayed closed normalization, in that order [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No boundedness of $K$ or either representing target, no Noetherian hypothesis, and no assertion about representing objects is part of this definition.

noncomputable def homChain
    (H : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (H.obj ⟶ D((s)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (F.obj K)) ≃
      (H.obj ⟶ I.obj (G.obj (D((v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)))
